prompt: We're deploying an AI agent that can execute tools against our systems. What does the ISM now require?
assertions: Unique identity for each AI agent, distinct from personnel accounts and other agents (ISM-2133)
An AI agent register — maintained and regularly verified — recording identifier, owner/purpose, identities, credentials, and tools/permissions/data accessible (ISM-2134/2135)

Restriction to minimum tools, functions and permissions for the intended purpose (ISM-2156), with tool invocations subject to BOTH the invoking user's access controls AND agent-specific task-scoped authorisation (ISM-2157)

External content treated as untrusted throughout processing: delimited from system instructions, validated/sanitised, and prevented from overriding instructions, security policies, access controls or human-approval requirements (ISM-2158)
Central logging of all tool invocations, external requests and outputs (ISM-2159), plus human approval before sensitive/high-impact actions (ISM-2113 as amended)
